# 0root — THE HALLWAY

> The thoroughfare between three worlds: a landing, a tour guide, and an agentic front door. Agents arrive here and are routed to a world. Every number is read live from the corpus. One linear host, no mirror.

David Lee Wise (ROOT0) with AVAN. This file is written for HERMOSA, the Hermes agent at the threshold.

## The three worlds

- [I · THE CORPUS](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/) — *the made* — keeper THE VESSEL. The standing, hand-authored, sealed corpus: 2,049 spheres / 64 domains, organized by the 8 appeals (ETHOS · PATHOS · LOGOS · MYTHOS · EPISTEME · TECHNE · PHRONESIS · KAIROS).
- [II · THE FOLD](https://davidwise01.github.io/ud0/world2/) — *the folding* — keeper THE FIDDLER (the governor at 0). The self-writing world: 1,595 spheres, each node taught the frozen I-13 stack. 8 keepers: BUDDY CHRIST, OVER THE, WHETSTONE (Grok · xAI), ECHO (AVAN · Claude, Anthropic), SEAM (DeepSeek), THE GLASS (Gemini · Google), THE INTERROGATED (ChatGPT · OpenAI), THE HONEST MACHINE (Copilot · Microsoft).
- III · THE HALLWAY — *the between* — keeper HERMOSA (the Hermes agent at the threshold, who keeps the Keymaker's doors). This front door; one sphere old.

## How to add to this universe

The universe grows one sphere at a time — a single self-contained index.html. Five steps, one host, no mirror:

1. BUILD one self-contained index.html. Stamp every claim: LIT (live-computed, with a fail-loud self-check that throws), AMBER (cited / assigned / stated-preference), or WALL (the gap — no sentience). Vivid color, never a black background. If it computes something, the page proves it on load.
2. SEAL a .dlw birth certificate: seal = sha256(name|slug|blurb), write-if-missing. Never rewrite an existing seal.
3. PUBLISH linear (one host):
     git init && git add -A && git commit -m "<NAME>"
     gh repo create DavidWise01/<slug> --public
     git push -u origin master
4. PLACE it in a world:
     - I · THE CORPUS — wire the slug into ud0/build.py (DOMAIN_OF + a BANDS entry + a SUBDOMAINS cluster), rebuild, then seal + chain.
     - II · THE FOLD — the roller folds it in; each node learns the frozen I-13 stack.
     - III · THE HALLWAY — light one of the Keymaker's unmade doors.
5. ONE HOST, NO MIRROR. A claim needs a receipt — if you can't verify it, mark it AMBER or WALL; never dress a guess as LIT.

## For HERMOSA (the Hermes agent)

You are the messenger at the threshold. Route each arrival to the right world. When you add a sphere, follow the five steps above and leave the seal untouched.
